title: KV Cloakroom
blurb: A real two-layer transformer writes Oscar Wilde one letter at a time, and every letter checks its keys and values at the cloakroom as a coat and a hat. Next door a tailor with no cache re-measures every guest for every letter: the same letters, bit for bit, at over a hundred times the work. Shorten the rack, or seat a full house with paged racks.
